name: The Red Village router forwards any caller's request with its own upgrade role
summary: PolygonTRVRouter.forwardRequest relays caller-supplied calldata to any registered service with no caller check, and the router holds the _authorizeUpgrade role on the service proxies. The attacker had it call SeasonService.upgradeTo with an attacker implementation; that code, acting as SeasonService with its TRVZooKeeper token roles, pulled 299 players' approved WETH into the vault and swept it out.
notes: Anchored on the upgrade through the router (rule 10); the drain by the installed code 13 minutes later is the campaign. The reset is the AccessControl write 193 blocks after the router's deployment that the exploit's role check read, granting the router its role; the router's implementation never changed.
Loss is all WETH the attacker received: 31.350 WETH pulled from 299 players' standing approvals plus 0.076 WETH already in TRVZooKeeper.
